title: The Episode of Malerkotla's Pathan Khawaja Khijar And the Death of his two Brothers

blocks.text: Sher Muhammad emerges as the one major survivor among that Pathan circle, his conduct distinguished from the worst of the others and remembered in relation to the earlier Sahibzada tragedy.
The dead are carried back toward Malerkotla, news of the disaster reaches Wazir Khan, and anxiety spreads through the Mughal side as confidence drains away.
The page uses Sher Muhammad as the hinge between battlefield loss and political fear, closing Episode 38 while setting up the next round of deliberation.
